style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFBFA;strokeColor=#FF3621;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=6;spacingRight=12;fontSize=9;fontColor=#3D4B55;" value="Why a Genie Space is the data product

A Genie Space is not a dashboard. It is a governed, versioned interface over a curated Gold slice: certified tables, metric views, example questions and instructions, all under one Unity Catalog permission model.

Downstream agents call it as a tool over MCP or the Conversational API. They ask in plain language, Genie writes SQL against the certified semantics, and the answer carries the caller's own permissions plus lineage back to the source table." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="130" width="900" x="620" y="930" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="attrib" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F7F6F2;strokeColor=#A8A59A;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=6;spacingRight=12;fontSize=9;fontColor=#5A6872;" value="Reference architecture. Component names follow Databricks product naming. Product icons come from the community databricks-architecture-icons project, which serves official Databricks artwork; the marks are trademarks of Databricks, Inc., used here for identification only. The artwork is used as published, unmodified. Icons are embedded, so the diagram renders without network access." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="130" width="800" x="1560" y="930" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Why a Genie Space is the data product
A Genie Space is not a dashboard. It is a governed, versioned interface over a curated Gold slice: certified tables, metric views, example questions and instructions, all under one Unity Catalog permission model.
Downstream agents call it as a tool over MCP or the Conversational API. They ask in plain language, Genie writes SQL against the certified semantics, and the answer carries the caller's own permissions plus lineage back to the source table.

div.div: Reference architecture. Component names follow Databricks product naming. Product icons come from the community databricks-architecture-icons project, which serves official Databricks artwork; the marks are trademarks of Databricks, Inc., used here for identification only. The artwork is used as published, unmodified. Icons are embedded, so the diagram renders without network access.
